title: 전원위원회 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Secretaries)
(1) The Committee of the Whole shall have one secretary from each negotiating group, and the secretaries of the National Assembly Steering Committee shall serve as the secretaries of the Committee of the Whole: Provided, That where a secretary of the National Assembly Steering Committee is unable to perform his or her duties for unavoidable reasons, the Chairperson of the Committee of the Whole shall appoint a secretary from among the members of the National Assembly Steering Committee belonging to the relevant negotiating group, upon the recommendation of the representative member of that negotiating group.
(2) Where the Chairperson of the Committee of the Whole is unable to perform his or her duties, a secretary designated by the Chairperson shall act on behalf of the Chairperson.
